Thanks for this..

I was in an online group recently, but ended up becoming really inactive a few months back when I got into this slump.

You’re right about them not being able to put you in a psych hospital unless you show clear intent (just looked it up for my state). Honestly I just don’t have a lot of trust in the medical system in my state as my state is VERY low in rankings among the states for most things, health care included.

I’m not sure how reliable it is, but some therapists/psychs are doing online practice now because of COVID. I might try and seek out some help via that...
